verdicts.title: On the circuit diameter conjecture for counterexamples to the Hirsch conjecture
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Circuit diameters of polyhedra are a fundamental tool for studying the complexity of circuit augmentation schemes for linear programming and for finding lower bounds on combinatorial diameters. The main open problem in this area is the circuit diameter conjecture, the analogue of the Hirsch conjecture in the circuit setting.
